title: Trail through cloud formation, Harmon Field sighting (Fig. 6)
description: Photograph showing a long, thin diagonal trail cutting across a cloud bank, with a strip of a second image (water/shoreline) visible at the right edge. Captioned "Fig. 6", it accompanies the Woodruff sighting near Harmon Field, Newfoundland. Text below summarises other 1947 reports, including Kenneth Arnold's sighting near Tacoma and disks seen from the tanker Ticonderoga.
